dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 11, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates Pull Off Upset Sweep of Brewers**

In a thrilling series finale, the Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6, completing a sweep of the two-game set. Esmerlyn Valdez delivered the knockout blow with a grand slam, his second home run of the day, to drive in four runs. Valdez finished 3-for-4 with two homers and six RBIs. Braxton Ashcraft earned his first win of the season for the Pirates, while Craig Yoho pitched two scoreless innings in relief.

In the Brewers' other loss, the Pirates took game two 3-2. Bubba Chandler threw 4.2 strong innings, striking out six and allowing two earned runs. Bryan Reynolds' RBI single in the bottom of the eighth proved to be the difference-maker. Valdez also contributed with a solo homer and two RBIs.

**Other Notable Performances**

Royce Lewis homered twice and drove in two runs for the Minnesota Twins in their 5-3 win over the Los Angeles Angels. Joe Ryan tossed six scoreless innings, striking out six and allowing two earned runs.

Gunnar Henderson hit his 17th homer of the season for the Baltimore Orioles in their 6-1 victory over the Kansas City Royals. Kyle Bradish pitched 6.2 strong innings, striking out five and allowing one earned run.

Paul Goldschmidt homered for the New York Yankees in their 4-2 win over the Washington Nationals. Cam Schlittler threw 6.2 innings, striking out six and allowing two earned runs.

James McCann homered twice and drove in four runs for the Arizona Diamondbacks in their 9-2 rout of the Los Angeles Dodgers.
